candidate_radius_m.description: Persons within this distance of the item become candidates
candidate_radius_m.title: Candidate Radius M

carry_weights.description: Feature weights once a carrier is committed (who has it now / HANDOFF)
carry_weights.title: Carry Weights

co_motion_window_s.description: Time window for co-motion and distance-trend evidence; time-bounded so pairs scored at different cadences stay comparable
co_motion_window_s.title: Co Motion Window S

pick_weights.description: Feature weights while attributing a PICK (who took it off the fixture)
pick_weights.title: Pick Weights

vision_min_confidence.description: Vision evidence below this confidence is ignored entirely
vision_min_confidence.title: Vision Min Confidence

ConfidenceThresholds.description: Single source of truth for confidence thresholds. No magic numbers elsewhere.

commit_min_confidence.description: Confidence at or above this may COMMIT
commit_min_confidence.title: Commit Min Confidence

commit_min_margin.description: Minimum gap between best and runner-up candidate to COMMIT
commit_min_margin.title: Commit Min Margin

max_wait_seconds.description: After waiting this long an unresolved event goes to REVIEW
max_wait_seconds.title: Max Wait Seconds

review_grace_seconds.description: Low confidence goes to REVIEW only after this grace period, so a new episode can still accumulate evidence
review_grace_seconds.title: Review Grace Seconds

wait_min_confidence.description: Confidence at or above this (but below commit) WAITs
wait_min_confidence.title: Wait Min Confidence

ConfidenceThresholds.title: ConfidenceThresholds

min_read_confidence.description: RFID reads below this confidence never refresh freshness, position, zone history or movement confirmation
min_read_confidence.title: Min Read Confidence

reset_after_s.description: After a gap this long the smoother restarts on the next read
reset_after_s.title: Reset After S

rest_init_reads.description: Reads needed before the initial rest position is trusted
rest_init_reads.title: Rest Init Reads

smoothing_alpha.description: EMA factor on RFID location estimates
smoothing_alpha.title: Smoothing Alpha

stale_after_s.description: No reads for this long -> position is stale, no motion inference
stale_after_s.title: Stale After S

velocity_window_s.description: Window for the half-mean velocity estimate
velocity_window_s.title: Velocity Window S

history_length.description: Points kept per track (~30 s at 20 Hz)
history_length.title: History Length

lost_after_s.description: No observation for this long -> LOST
lost_after_s.title: Lost After S

merge_radius_m.description: A new native track within this distance of an existing canonical track (observed by a different sensor) is the same person
merge_radius_m.title: Merge Radius M

min_observation_confidence.description: Person observations below this confidence are ignored entirely
min_observation_confidence.title: Min Observation Confidence

prediction_horizon_s.description: Maximum dead-reckoning horizon when a LOST track's position is needed
prediction_horizon_s.title: Prediction Horizon S

reacquire_growth_m_per_s.description: Re-acquisition gate grows by this much per second lost
reacquire_growth_m_per_s.title: Reacquire Growth M Per S

reacquire_window_s.description: A LOST track may be re-acquired within this window
reacquire_window_s.title: Reacquire Window S

same_sensor_exclusion_s.description: A canonical track updated by sensor X within this window cannot absorb a second native track from sensor X
same_sensor_exclusion_s.title: Same Sensor Exclusion S

candidate_timeout_s.description: INTERACTION_CANDIDATE not progressing reverts after this
candidate_timeout_s.title: Candidate Timeout S

carry_displacement_m.description: Displacement from rest to become CARRIED
carry_displacement_m.title: Carry Displacement M

exit_item_radius_m.description: Item within this distance of an exiting carrier leaves with them
exit_item_radius_m.title: Exit Item Radius M

exit_zone_burst_window_s.description: The portal burst must fit inside this window
exit_zone_burst_window_s.title: Exit Zone Burst Window S

exit_zone_confirm_reads.description: Consecutive reads from an EXIT zone (a portal burst) that close a carried episode even without localization; a single stray read from a far read point is not
exit_zone_confirm_reads.title: Exit Zone Confirm Reads

hold_radius_m.description: A resting item with any tracked person closer than this may still be held in hand, so PUTBACK/MISPLACE is deferred until they step away
hold_radius_m.title: Hold Radius M

home_radius_m.description: Rest within this distance of the home fixture bounds = PUTBACK
home_radius_m.title: Home Radius M

home_zone_margin_m.description: Leaving the home fixture bounds by this margin also implies carry
home_zone_margin_m.title: Home Zone Margin M

movement_confirm_reads.description: Consecutive evaluations, each backed by at least one new localized RFID read, with the smoothed estimate beyond the threshold before INTERACTION_CANDIDATE. In read-sparse zones this scales with the read interval, not the fusion step
movement_confirm_reads.title: Movement Confirm Reads

movement_threshold_m.description: Displacement from rest to become INTERACTION_CANDIDATE
movement_threshold_m.title: Movement Threshold M

physical_event_confidence.description: Confidence for rest/exit facts backed by fresh reads
physical_event_confidence.title: Physical Event Confidence

rest_confirm_s.description: At-rest condition must hold this long before PUTBACK/MISPLACE
rest_confirm_s.title: Rest Confirm S

rest_displacement_m.description: Half-window mean displacement below this (for the whole window) = at rest
rest_displacement_m.title: Rest Displacement M

rest_window_s.description: Window over which a carried item must stop moving
rest_window_s.title: Rest Window S

vision_enabled.description: Whether a vision provider is wired in; changes association weight normalization, so it is recorded and restored on replay
vision_enabled.title: Vision Enabled
